title: Pip and Ned at the Gap
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 1 — Phase 4: CVCC words: two consonant sounds together at the end (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 63-sound stage (pr, sc, sk just added). A gentle story about racing for fun rather than to win.

pages.text: Pip and Ned run to the gap.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Ned the duckling side by side, about to run toward a tall green gap.
Pip hopping quickly across the grass toward the gap.
Ned hopping quickly across the grass toward the gap, just behind Pip.
Pip the sparrow arriving at the green gap, slightly ahead.

pages.text: Ned is not at the gap yet.
pages.illustration: Pip looking back, with Ned still partway across the grass.
Pip the sparrow waiting patiently beside the gap.
Ned the duckling arriving at the gap, a little out of breath.

pages.text: Pip and Ned sit at the gap.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Ned the duckling sitting together beside the gap.
Pip and Ned both laughing together, clearly enjoying themselves.
